PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: All of Floyd's squares are in row 4, so nobody else can use it. Using Gideon's clue ("He was exactly two columns east of Brenda."), some squares are ruled out for Brenda. So Brenda (B) must be at row 5, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Emil's clue ("He was with Alma.") needs a partner who does not share his row or column; that rules out squares for Emil. The murderer must be in Virgil's area without sharing his row or column; that rules out squares for Virgil. Suppose Alma were at row 3, column 8: then Emil's clue ("He was with Alma.") could not be true. So Alma can't be there. The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. All of Desmond's squares are in column 5, so nobody else can use it. All of Gideon's squares are in column 6, so nobody else can use it. Emil's own clue ("He was with Alma. He was in a corner of his area.") rules out more squares. So Emil (E) must be at row 6, column 8. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Brenda and Emil crossed out, only one square is left for Desmond that fits his clue ("He was in the Gazebo or the Pond."). So Desmond (D) must be at row 8, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Alma that fits her clue ("She was not in a car."). So Alma (A) must be at row 7, column 7. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Suppose Floyd were at row 4, column 1: then Cora would have nowhere left to go. So Floyd can't be there. So Floyd (F) must be at row 4, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Suppose Cora were at row 3, column 3: then the general clue ("There was exactly one person beside a tree.") could not be true. So Cora can't be there. So Cora (C) must be at row 1, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Using the general clue ("There was exactly one person beside a tree."), some squares are ruled out for Virgil. So Virgil (the victim) must be at row 3, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Gideon that fits his clue ("He was exactly two columns east of Brenda."). So Gideon (G) must be at row 2, column 6. Cross out his row and column. Cora is the only person in the Orchard with Virgil, so Cora is the murderer!
